summary.text: Ryan Mishler is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 9, which covers portions of Elkhart, Kosciusko, Marshall and St. Joseph counties, since 2004.
He chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee and is president of Mishler Memorials.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Mishler earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Southern California and attended Worsham College of Mortuary Science.
He also sits on the Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee and the State Budget Committee.

The page lists his activities as including the Bremen and Kosciusko County chambers of commerce, Sons of The American Legion Post 191, Bremen Masonic Lodge #414 and membership in the United Methodist Church.
